text:
ops-ryan: Vendor update — GreenCargo reports a partial DOA/thermal mismatch for a 20-unit A800 shipment landed at FRA crossdock. Vendor's assessment: 12 units showing thermal delta on boot ("therm_trip" alert), 8 units pass inspection. Vendor proposal attached: air-ship 8 immediate replacements, hold 12 for depot triage/refurb with a 5% credit option, or expedited air for more at €4,200/unit. AWB GL123456789. Pics: <link:vendor-upload/GL123456789/photos>. Need quick ops decision: expedite more replacements vs accept credit + temporary re-routing.

supply-julia: can you paste the serial manifest? I need to reconcile with our fleet ledger before we move any reserves.

vendor-greencargo: Hi all — serials and quick manifest below, photos are the ones we uploaded. ETA for air batch (8 units) = 5 biz days from pickup. Sea wave for refurb/replace = 21-28 days. AWB/ETA and contact in email. Quote for expedited >8: €4,200/unit (air DDP). We can provide proof-of-damage photos and depot triage report on request. Serial list: A800-XS-1001..A800-XS-1020 (see attached CSV).

infra-ian: couple things — EU region is tight this week, our EU pool has only 6 hot spares; we have 10 free in us-west but lead time to move them + customs is non-trivial. If we accept 8 air replacements from vendor, that covers immediate capacity, but if we need >8 we'll have to route from US (inc costs + ~48h transit to FRA). What's the expected impact on queued jobs if we drop 12 units?

sre-anya: quick note on the thermal alerts — can we run the remote health dump on the flagged serials before we accept DOA? Many times crossdock thermal sensors or transit shock triggers an initial "therm_trip" that clears after a cold boot. I'd prefer depot triage before full RMA issuance for those where possible. If vendor can attach the boot logs that helps.

legal-lee: please include warranty clause confirmation from GreenCargo — who bears the insurance/damage claim if DOT/Crossdock mishandled? Also need vendor to confirm RMA SLA and replacement liability. Do not issue any PO changes until we have written confirmation.

ops-ryan: @supply-julia can you pull the manifest vs ledger? @vendor-greencargo can you provide the boot logs for the 12 flagged units (simple syslog or `dmesg` output). Proposal from ops: expedite 6 units air (cover urgent EU-facing pools) and move 4 units from US burst pool to FRA as temporary hot spares. That should keep latency SLOs while depot triages the remaining 10.

supply-julia: I can move 4 from us-west dedicated pool. Cost estimate: same-day air + customs handling ~€12,000 total for 4 units (incl broker). I'll prep PO amendment if legal signs off. I need vendor-confirmed AWB for the 6 expedited from their side to coordinate customs handoff.

vendor-greencargo: Confirmed — we can carve out 6 expedited for air and will provide a new AWB for those: AWB GL987654321 (pickup scheduled tomorrow). We'll attach triage logs for the held units and provide depot photo sheet. We'll also confirm insurance claim initiation under our freight SLA.

deploy-bot: Job scheduled: ``fleet:swap-reserve`` for 4 units transfer (job_id=swap-1769516000) — ETA runway 48h, requires supply PO + customs docs.

sre-anya: I'll open a canary routing to drain impacted nodes and mark the 12 serials as 'quarantine' in the inventory UI. If vendor provides logs/pics we can triage faster. Also add a temporary autoscale tweak to spin up a few cheaper CPU-backed workers if needed.

ops-ryan: OK proceeding with plan: 6 vendor air, 4 us-west transfer. @legal-lee please confirm we can proceed on PO amendment for the carrier fees; @supply-julia prep change order. I'll update channel with AWB numbers + customs docs as they arrive. :thumbsup:

supply-julia: noted — prepping PO and will ping procurement for fast-track approval.

legal-lee: I'll review the vendor confirmation and insurance terms once they send the depot triage report. No PO signature until liability clause confirmed.

ops-ryan: thanks everyone — tracking here. Will paste AWB and customs fax once vendor sends. If anything changes ping me in DMs and I'll mirror here for audit.
